shortest_safe_sequence.rationale: Prerequisite: cannot validate any MCP-mediated workflow without a real client exercising the server over stdio.

shortest_safe_sequence.rationale: Workers need to preview what auto_pickup would claim before committing. Safety prerequisite for wave execution.

shortest_safe_sequence.rationale: Reuse static allowlists from launch_queue_contract.py. Prevent unauthorized runner/topic strings from mutating queue.

shortest_safe_sequence.label: Add batch pre/post collision guard validation
shortest_safe_sequence.rationale: Extend B107 single-task preflight to batch: validate no collisions before wave start and after wave end.

shortest_safe_sequence.label: Execute one full MCP-mediated task wave (claim→work→review→done)
shortest_safe_sequence.rationale: The goal: prove MCP can mediate the entire task lifecycle without manual copy/paste.

shortest_safe_sequence.label: Validate no parent-repo task state corruption after wave
shortest_safe_sequence.rationale: Post-wave: run taskctl verify, compare pre/post queue integrity, JSONL consistency.
